preq.title: Patient requests
preq.note: Requests patients made about their own record: erasure, a correction (the detail's name only, never a value) and a nominee. There is no text in a request. Changing a status tells the patient with an in-app notice and is recorded under your name.
preq.confirmBody: The patient is told with an in-app notice. It is recorded under your name. Nothing about the record is changed by this step.
preq.link: Link an erasure request you started for this patient
preq.invalid: That change is not allowed from the current status. Nothing was recorded.
preq.gone: This request was not found. Nothing was recorded.

result.recorded: Recorded. The patient has been told.
result.invalid_transition: That change is not allowed from the current status. Nothing was recorded.
